                text=log_path.read_text();assert proc.poll() is None,text
                m=re.search(r"Uvicorn running on http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:(\d+)",text)
                if m:
                    port=int(m.group(1))
                    try:
                        with opener.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health",timeout=1) as response:

                command=[py,"live_client.py","--port",str(port)]
